title: 抬头之前
intent: 陪伴汇报前约三分钟的准备：从呼吸稍急、注意力分散，逐渐走向清醒而稳定的专注；结束时仍留有一点警觉。

tempo.feel: 4/4，轻微摇摆的稳定律动；留出宽裕的乐句间隙

tonality.mode: 布鲁斯调性，以E7、A7、B7为主要和声

instrumentation.name: 干净音色的电吉他
instrumentation.role: 奏出简短主题，并在重现时使旋律更完整
instrumentation.timbre: 温暖、清晰；克制的推弦与蓝调音，句尾留白

instrumentation.name: 钢琴
instrumentation.role: 以疏朗和弦回应吉他，维持和声方向
instrumentation.timbre: 柔和、颗粒清楚，避免密集装饰

instrumentation.name: 原声贝斯
instrumentation.role: 提供可靠、不过分忙碌的低音脉搏

instrumentation.name: 鼓组
instrumentation.role: 以轻刷奏和低调底鼓维持向前的力量
instrumentation.timbre: 细腻、均匀，不作突兀的加花

structure.direction: 贝斯与轻刷奏先建立脉搏；钢琴铺开稀疏和声，吉他提出略带悬念的短句。
吉他奏出带停顿的主题，钢琴在句间回应；律动稳定，给呼吸留下空间。
围绕主题作小幅旋律变化；钢琴回应稍趋明确，低音与鼓保持原有力度，不制造高潮。
主题以更连贯的乐句返回，和声更稳，呈现思路重新聚拢的感觉。
乐器逐步收束，吉他以简短句子落向安定的终止；保留一点蓝调音带来的清醒张力。

production: 近距离、清晰而不过分干燥的录音；钢琴和吉他彼此分明，贝斯与鼓保持柔和的推进。干净的录音室录制，原声乐器音色自然，并保留电吉他的干净放大音色；瞬态平顺，峰值受控。
avoid: 突兀的强奏或节奏变化
assumptions: 采用约80 BPM的轻摇摆布鲁斯律动。
以吉他和钢琴的问答表现注意力逐渐聚拢。
时长遵循应用设置，约三分钟。
lyriaPrompt: Create an original three-minute instrumental blues piece for the few minutes before an important presentation: initially a little tense, then steadily clearer and more grounded, alert rather than sleepy. Instrumental only, no vocals. At about 80 BPM in 4/4, use a gently swung, restrained groove and E blues harmony centered on E7, A7 and B7. A clean electric guitar leads with short, expressive phrases, subtle blue notes and audible pauses for breathing; a softly played piano answers between phrases. Upright bass and lightly brushed drums provide a dependable, quiet forward pulse. [Intro] Establish the pulse sparsely, then introduce an unsettled guitar phrase. [Theme] Let guitar and piano exchange a simple, memorable motif with generous space. [Development] Vary the motif slightly and make the responses more assured without a sudden swell. [Return] Bring back the motif in a more connected, settled form. [Outro] Thin the texture and end with a clear, gentle cadence that retains a trace of blues tension. Keep the instruments distinct and close, with natural acoustic timbres for piano, bass and drums and a clean amplified guitar tone. Clean studio recording, smooth transients and controlled peaks. No vocals, abrupt dynamic shifts, clipping, crackling or digital distortion.
